$comment: This plugin does NOT bundle MCP servers: a plugin's .mcp.json can only ship stdio servers it launches itself, and every connector below is a remote connector the user connects in their own account. This file documents them as prerequisites; it intentionally defines no servers.

requiredConnectors.name: Notion
requiredConnectors.purpose: The pipeline database. Routine reads go through saved views (quota-exempt).

requiredConnectors.name: Gmail
requiredConnectors.purpose: Read-only inbox reconciliation and LinkedIn job-alert digests.

requiredConnectors.name: Google Drive (optional)
requiredConnectors.purpose: Reading the master resume by id and recording Drive links on tailored documents.

requiredConnectors.name: Claude in Chrome extension (recommended)
requiredConnectors.purpose: LinkedIn postings and ATS forms behind logins.
